thread:
Jon (AE): EdgeSystems sent an RFI that keeps popping up. They're asking for an 'edge connector' that runs in their VPC, private control plane, customer-managed HSM with import, and the ability to opt-out of any telemetry/usage reporting. They want a 2-week POC focused on embeddings throughput + chat latency and a simple capability matrix for exec review. Can SE/Infra/Security triage?
Priya (SE): On telemetry opt-out: we can minimize telemetry but some telemetry is needed for SLOs (health, errors). We need to confirm which signals they require opt-out for. Also need qps, avg tokens, and whether they plan concurrent chat + embed mix.
Jon (AE): They've indicated 30 qps embed steady, 200 qps burst, chat is low-volume (~5 concurrents). Avg embed tokens 256, chat avg 128. They specifically called out 'no metric shipment of input text' and 'no cross-tenant metadata retention'.
Sam (SalesEng): Recommended POC: Week0 prep (network, credentials), Week1 deploy model on Private, run perf harness with KV caching + batch sizing, Week2 customer integration + acceptance. For cost: offer a 4-week reserved eval estimate vs Hosted. I'll sketch numbers.
Nora (Infra): VPC peering + routing is fine; we need their CIDR, ACLs, and whether they allow PrivateLink. Also need to know if the HSM is reachable via private network or needs a gateway. We'll need infra ticket for peering.
Ellen (Security): HSM import: we support KMIP and PKCS#11 workflows in Private. For signed key import we need the attestations and an approved key ceremony. Telemetry opt-out: we can toggle PII scrubbing and disable request body telemetry, but will still collect anonymized performance metrics (latency, errors). Need their legal confirmation on acceptance criteria.
LegalBot: Uploaded standard KMS addendum draft and SOC2 redacted: https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/kms-addendum-draft.pdf https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/soc2-2025.pdf. Created ticket LEG-8244 for contract changes.
Priya (SE): I'll build a lightweight harness container and a load script. Sample command for harness run:
```
docker run --rm redwood/poc-harness:latest \
  --endpoint https://poc.redwood.private --token $POC_TOKEN \
  --model rwd-embed-2026 --qps 30 --tokens 256 --duration 600
```
I'll also include a small latency probe for chat: 50 concurrent sessions, 128 tokens each.
Sam (SalesEng): Cost comparison back-of-envelope (rough): Hosted per-token (embeds) ~= $0.0008/token * (30 qps * 256 tokens * 3600 * 24 * 30) = ballpark X; Dedicated 2xA100 reserved = flat monthly ~$18k with lower unit cost. I'll compute and post a table in Drive.
Jon (AE): Customer asked about data residency: they want all logs stored in their region only and deleted on demand. Can we support region-scoped log storage for Private?
Nora (Infra): Yes for Private we can configure log retention to their S3 and ensure no cross-region replication. We'll need the S3 bucket details and an IAM role for write access.
Ellen (Security): Also flagged: they require documentation of subprocessors and the ability to disable third-party telemetry. We'll provide subprocessors.csv and a checklist for disabling.
Priya (SE): I'll drop the harness and a sample workload generator in the shared drive: https://drive.redwood/team-sales/pocs/edgesys-connector. Please put the RFI spreadsheet there.
Sam (SalesEng): Scheduling a quick sync with EdgeSystems tomorrow 10am PT to confirm acceptance criteria and network details. Agenda will include: HSM import flow, telemetry opt-out, perf targets, and acceptance tests.
Jon (AE): Thanks. Goal: deliver a capability matrix + commercial estimate within 48 hours post-sync. Everyone please add any docs to the Drive link. :thumbsup:
